pages.text: The Sanctum hides $(thing)1 to 3 active nests$() among 5 nest rooms. Hit a nest ($(thing)10 hits$()) to dig up its egg.$(br2)Four rarities: common, rare, epic and legendary.
An egg is $(bad)heavy$(): it slows you down, even more if it's epic or legendary. If you die, you drop it.
Get out alive with the egg: it becomes $(good)secured$(), in your name, and gives you Hunter XP and Shells.$(br2)Eggs can't be sold: hatch them in an $(l:companions/incubator)incubator$().
pages.title: Extraction
